# Type I and II Error (Power) Explorer: 2-arm trial, continuous endpoint, 1-sided test # Shiny app: single file (app.R) # Adapted from the Type I and II Error Demo QMD (R-CONIS MDD vs target concept) library(shiny) library(dplyr) library(tibble) library(purrr) library(ggplot2) library(plotly) if (FALSE) library(jsonlite) # used via jsonlite:: for downloads `%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a # ── Core calculations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # Two-sample comparison of means, equal allocation, common SD, 1-sided test. # The t-test power uses the non-central t distribution, which is what rpact's # getPowerMeans(normalApproximation = FALSE) uses for a fixed (kMax = 1) design. std_err <- function(n, sd) sd * sqrt(2 / n) # Power at a given true effect size. ncp is clipped to +/-37 because pt() with # a non-central parameter is not reliable beyond about 37.6 (power there is # 0 or 1 to machine precision anyway). power_fun <- function(eff, n, sd, alpha, normal = FALSE) { ncp <- eff / std_err(n, sd) if (normal) return(pnorm(ncp - qnorm(1 - alpha))) df <- 2 * n - 2 tcrit <- qt(1 - alpha, df) suppressWarnings( pt(tcrit, df, ncp = pmax(pmin(ncp, 37), -37), lower.tail = FALSE) ) } # 1-sided p-value for an observed effect size pval_fun <- function(eff, n, sd, normal = FALSE) { z <- eff / std_err(n, sd) if (normal) pnorm(z, lower.tail = FALSE) else pt(z, 2 * n - 2, lower.tail = FALSE) } # Minimum detectable difference: smallest observed effect with 1-sided p <= alpha mdd_fun <- function(n, sd, alpha, normal = FALSE) { q <- if (normal) qnorm(1 - alpha) else qt(1 - alpha, 2 * n - 2) q * std_err(n, sd) } # True effect size at which power equals p (vectorised over p) effect_at_power <- function(p, n, sd, alpha, normal = FALSE) { se <- std_err(n, sd) if (normal) return((qnorm(1 - alpha) + qnorm(p)) * se) df <- 2 * n - 2 tcrit <- qt(1 - alpha, df) vapply(p, function(pi) { f <- function(ncp) { suppressWarnings(pt(tcrit, df, ncp = ncp, lower.tail = FALSE)) - pi } r <- tryCatch(uniroot(f, c(-30, 37), tol = 1e-10)$root, error = function(e) NA_real_) r * se }, numeric(1)) } # "Nice" major tick spacing (1, 2, 5 x 10^k) giving roughly `target` ticks nice_dtick <- function(width, target = 10) { raw <- width / target mag <- 10^floor(log10(raw)) m <- raw / mag mag * if (m < 1.5) 1 else if (m < 3.5) 2 else if (m < 7.5) 5 else 10 } # Read plotly events from the power plot (source "tm"). The server observers # start before the plot has rendered and registered its events, which makes # plotly warn that the event is not registered; the events work once the plot # exists, so the warning is suppressed here. ev_data <- function(event, priority = "input") { suppressWarnings(event_data(event, source = "tm", priority = priority)) } # Parse a comma/space separated list of numbers parse_nums <- function(x) { if (is.null(x)) return(numeric(0)) v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(trimws(x), "[,;[:space:]]+")))) v[!is.na(v)] } # ── Distribution plot helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────── # Colours for plot 2. alpha_col is the dark red sampled from the reference site # (about rgb(177, 69, 53)); change it here if you want a different shade. alpha_col <- "rgba(177, 69, 53, 0.55)" # dark red: alpha (Type I error) area beta_col <- "rgba(27, 94, 32, 0.55)" # dark green: beta (Type II error) area # The last number in alpha_col and beta_col is the opacity (1 = solid). grey_col <- "#6E6E6E" # null (solid) and alternative (dotted) # Densities on the effect size scale. Null: central t (or normal) centred at 0. # Alternative: non-central t (or normal) centred at eff. The t versions match # the power calculation used in plot 1. ncp is clipped as in power_fun(). dens_null <- function(x, se, df, normal = FALSE) { if (normal) dnorm(x / se) / se else dt(x / se, df) / se } dens_alt <- function(x, eff, se, df, normal = FALSE) { if (normal) return(dnorm((x - eff) / se) / se) suppressWarnings(dt(x / se, df, ncp = max(min(eff / se, 37), -37))) / se } # Scalar summaries for a selection (effect size and N) dist_stats <- function(s, d) { se <- std_err(s$n, d$sd) df <- 2 * s$n - 2 crit <- if (d$normal) qnorm(1 - d$alpha) * se else qt(1 - d$alpha, df) * se pow <- power_fun(s$eff, s$n, d$sd, d$alpha, d$normal) list(se = se, df = df, crit = crit, power = pow, beta = 1 - pow) } src_label <- function(src) { switch(src, locked = "locked", hover = "last hovered", default = "default: effect size giving the target power, first N") } # Everything plot 2 needs for one selection: trace data, names, shapes, # annotations and title. Used for both the initial render and proxy updates. dist_calc <- function(s, d, rng, f = 1) { st <- dist_stats(s, d) xs <- seq(rng$x[1], rng$x[2], length.out = 1001) yn <- dens_null(xs, st$se, st$df, d$normal) ya <- dens_alt(xs, s$eff, st$se, st$df, d$normal) xa <- c(st$crit, xs[xs > st$crit]) yar <- dens_null(xa, st$se, st$df, d$normal) xb <- c(xs[xs < st$crit], st$crit) ybr <- dens_alt(xb, s$eff, st$se, st$df, d$normal) f2 <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2) fmt1 <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 1) eff_txt <- f2(s$eff) # Beta rounded first, so the displayed beta and power add to exactly 100% b_r <- round(100 * st$beta, 1) p_r <- 100 - b_r shapes <- list(list( type = "line", xref = "x", x0 = st$crit, x1 = st$crit, yref = "paper", y0 = 0, y1 = 1, line = list(dash = "dash", color = "black", width = 1) )) annots <- list( list(xref = "x", yref = "y", x = 0, y = dens_null(0, st$se, st$df, d$normal), yanchor = "bottom", text = "H0", showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 14 * f)), list(xref = "x", yref = "y", x = s$eff, y = max(ya), yanchor = "bottom", text = "H1", showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 14 * f)), # Placed just above the plot area, on top of the critical value line, so # it cannot overlap the H0 / H1 labels inside the plot. list(xref = "x", yref = "paper", x = st$crit, xanchor = "center", y = 1, yanchor = "bottom", align = "center", showarrow = FALSE, text = paste0("Critical value = ", f2(st$crit), "
Power = ", fmt1(p_r), "%"), font = list(size = 11 * f)) ) list( xs = xs, yn = yn, ya = ya, xa = xa, yar = yar, xb = xb, ybr = ybr, names = c( "Null (H0): effect size 0", paste0("Alternative (H1): effect size ", eff_txt), paste0("alpha (Type I error) = ", format(100 * d$alpha, digits = 3), "%"), paste0("beta (Type II error) = ", fmt1(b_r), "%, power = ", fmt1(p_r), "%") ), shapes = shapes, annots = annots, title = paste0( "H1 effect size = ", eff_txt, ", N = ", s$n, " per arm (", src_label(s$src), ")", "
1-sided alpha = ", d$alpha, ", SD = ", d$sd, if (d$normal) ", normal approximation" else ", t-test", "" ) ) } # ── Help tooltip helper (same approach as the Bayesian Binomial app) ────────── help_icon <- function(text) { # Click-to-show popover (Bootstrap), dismissed by clicking elsewhere. # Both data-* and data-bs-* attributes are set so it works with Bootstrap 3 or 5. tags$span( "\u24d8", class = "help-icon", tabindex = "0", role = "button", `data-toggle` = "popover", `data-bs-toggle` = "popover", `data-trigger` = "focus", `data-bs-trigger` = "focus", `data-placement` = "right", `data-bs-placement` = "right", `data-content` = text, `data-bs-content` = text, style = "cursor: pointer; color: #337ab7; margin-left: 6px; font-weight: bold;" ) } labelled <- function(label, help) { tags$div( style = "display:flex; align-items:center;", tags$label(label, style = "margin-bottom: 0;"), help_icon(help) ) } n_help <- paste0( "Patients per arm. Enter one number (e.g. 175) or two separated by a comma ", "(e.g. 175, 113). The second value is overlaid with dotted lines. ", "Default vertical reference lines and markers always refer to the first value." ) test_help <- paste0( "t-test uses the non-central t distribution with 2n - 2 degrees of freedom ", "(as rpact with normalApproximation = FALSE). Normal approximation uses the ", "standard normal distribution." ) alpha_help <- "1-sided significance level. A 1-sided 0.025 equals a 2-sided 0.05." target_help <- paste0( "Target power as a percentage (e.g. enter 90 for 90%). With markers ", "switched on, a marker is placed at the effect size that gives this power ", "for the first N." ) href_help <- paste0( "Horizontal dashed reference lines, as percentages on the primary y-axis, ", "comma-separated (e.g. 2.5, 50, 90). The same heights read as 1-sided ", "p-values of 0.025, 0.5 and 0.9 on the secondary axis." ) vauto_help <- paste0( "Vertical dashed lines placed at the true effect size where the power curve ", "for the first N reaches each of these power levels (%)." ) vextra_help <- "Extra vertical dashed lines at these effect sizes, comma-separated." plots_help <- paste0( "Choose which plots to display. At least one must stay selected. The ", "distributions plot follows the effect size and N of the curve you hover over ", "in the power plot. Click the power plot to lock the distributions at that ", "point, and click again to release." ) marker_help <- paste0( "For the first N: power at effect size 0 (equals alpha), the minimum ", "detectable difference (MDD; observed effect with 1-sided p = alpha) shown ", "on both curves, and the effect size giving the target power." ) # ── UI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # ---- footer for exported PNG and PDF files: notice, app address, UTC date and time ---- APP_URL <- "https://kinnersleyn.github.io/kcl-apps/T12E/" export_footer <- function() { txt <- sprintf("For educational purposes only, not for decision-making. %s Generated %s UTC", APP_URL, format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")) fs <- 7 w <- grid::convertWidth(grid::grobWidth(grid::textGrob(txt, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = fs))), "npc", valueOnly = TRUE) if (w > 0.96) fs <- fs * 0.96 / w grid::grid.text(txt, y = grid::unit(2.5, "mm"), gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = fs, col = "grey35")) } # viewport that leaves room at the bottom of the page for the footer footer_vp <- function() grid::viewport(y = grid::unit(0.25, "in"), height = grid::unit(1, "npc") - grid::unit(0.25, "in"), just = "bottom") # ---- educational-use banner shown at the top of the app ---- edu_banner <- tagList( tags$style(HTML(".edu-banner{background:#fff4d6;border:1px solid #e0b64a;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 12px;margin:6px 0 10px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.35;color:#5c4400;}")), tags$div(class = "edu-banner", role = "note", tags$strong("For educational purposes only. "), "This app uses simulated or illustrative data and has not been validated. It must not be used for decision-making, including the design, conduct or interpretation of any real clinical trial or any decision about patient care.") ) ui <- fluidPage( edu_banner, tags$head( # Tell the server when plotly.js and crosstalk are loaded, so plots are not drawn too early tags$script(HTML(paste0("$(document).on('shiny:connected', function(){", "var t=setInterval(function(){", "if (typeof Plotly!=='undefined' && typeof crosstalk!=='undefined') {", "clearInterval(t); Shiny.setInputValue('plotly_ready', true);}}, 100);});"))), tags$script(HTML(paste0("$(document).on('shiny:connected', function(){", "Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('save_file', function(m){", "var bin=atob(m.b64), n=bin.length, bytes=new Uint8Array(n);", "for (var i=0;i -1", plotlyOutput("plot", height = "620px") ), conditionalPanel( "input.show_plots && input.show_plots.indexOf('p2') > -1", uiOutput("dist_status"), plotlyOutput("dist_plot", height = "460px") ) ) ) ) # ── Server ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── server <- function(input, output, session) { # plotly checks, after the first flush, that every event read with # event_data() was registered by a rendered plot. The power plot cannot render # until the debounced inputs have settled, so that check ran too early and # produced "event ... is not registered" warnings. The plot does register # these events (event_register() in the plot code) once it renders, so list # them as registered up front. session$userData$plotlyShinyEventIDs <- unique(c( session$userData$plotlyShinyEventIDs, paste(c("plotly_relayout", "plotly_hover", "plotly_click"), "tm", sep = "-") )) # Debounce the free-text inputs so partially typed values are not evaluated ns_r <- debounce(reactive(parse_nums(input$n_text)), 500) href_r <- debounce(reactive(parse_nums(input$h_ref)), 500) vpower_r <- debounce(reactive(parse_nums(input$v_power)), 500) vextra_r <- debounce(reactive(parse_nums(input$v_extra)), 500) normal_r <- reactive(input$test == "normal") # ── Validated design parameters ───────────────────────────────────────────── design <- reactive({ ns <- ns_r() validate( need(length(ns) %in% 1:2, "Enter one or two values for the number of patients per arm."), need(all(ns >= 2), "Patients per arm must be at least 2."), need(!is.na(input$sd) && input$sd > 0, "SD must be positive."), need(!is.na(input$alpha) && input$alpha > 0 && input$alpha < 0.5, "alpha (1-sided) must be between 0 and 0.5."), need(!is.na(input$target_power) && input$target_power > 0 && input$target_power < 100, "Target power (%) must be a percentage between 0 and 100 (e.g. 90)."), need(!anyNA(c(input$eff_min, input$eff_max, input$eff_step)) && input$eff_max > input$eff_min && input$eff_step > 0, "Effect size range: max must exceed min and step must be positive."), need((input$eff_max - input$eff_min) / input$eff_step <= 5000, "Too many grid points (limit 5000). Increase the step.") ) list(ns = ns, sd = input$sd, alpha = input$alpha, tp = input$target_power / 100, normal = normal_r()) }) # ── Curves: one row per (N, effect size) ──────────────────────────────────── curves <- reactive({ d <- design() eff <- seq(input$eff_min, input$eff_max, by = input$eff_step) map_dfr(d$ns, \(n) tibble( N = n, Effect = eff, Power = power_fun(eff, n, d$sd, d$alpha, d$normal), PValue = pval_fun(eff, n, d$sd, d$normal) )) }) # ── Vertical reference lines ──────────────────────────────────────────────── vlines <- reactive({ d <- design() auto <- numeric(0) if (isTRUE(input$auto_v)) { p <- vpower_r() / 100 p <- p[p > 0 & p < 1] if (length(p) > 0) { auto <- effect_at_power(p, d$ns[1], d$sd, d$alpha, d$normal) } } v <- c(auto, vextra_r()) sort(unique(round(v[!is.na(v)], 6))) }) # Axis ranges used when the plot is (re)built. Isolated so that zooming # (which updates the numeric inputs) does not rebuild the plot. axis_ranges <- function() { xr <- c(input$x_min, input$x_max) yr <- c(input$y_min, input$y_max) / 100 if (anyNA(xr) || xr[1] >= xr[2]) xr <- c(input$eff_min, input$eff_max) if (anyNA(yr) || yr[1] >= yr[2]) yr <- c(0, 1) list(x = xr, y = yr) } # ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── output$plot <- renderPlotly({ req(isTRUE(input$plotly_ready)) d <- design() cv <- curves() vl <- vlines() hl <- href_r() / 100 ax <- isolate(axis_ranges()) f <- plot_f() # font / margin scale from the plot-size slider blue <- "#0000FF" red <- "#FF0000" ns <- d$ns p <- plot_ly(source = "tm") for (i in seq_along(ns)) { n <- ns[i] di <- cv[cv$N == n, ] dash <- c("solid", "dot")[i] lab <- paste0("N = ", n, " per arm") p <- p |> add_trace( type = "scatter", mode = "lines", x = di$Effect, y = di$Power, yaxis = "y", name = paste0("Power, ", lab), line = list(color = blue, dash = dash, width = 2), hovertemplate = paste0( lab, "
Effect size: %{x:.2f}
Power: %{y:.2%}" ), hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = blue, font = list(color = "white")) ) |> add_trace( type = "scatter", mode = "lines", x = di$Effect, y = di$PValue, yaxis = "y2", name = paste0("1-sided p-value, ", lab), line = list(color = red, dash = dash, width = 2), hovertemplate = paste0( lab, "
Effect size: %{x:.2f}
1-sided p-value: %{y:.4f}" ), hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = red, font = list(color = "white")) ) } # Markers for the first N if (isTRUE(input$markers)) { n1 <- ns[1] mdd <- mdd_fun(n1, d$sd, d$alpha, d$normal) eff_tp <- effect_at_power(d$tp, n1, d$sd, d$alpha, d$normal) pw_mdd <- power_fun(mdd, n1, d$sd, d$alpha, d$normal) bx <- c(0, mdd) by <- c(power_fun(0, n1, d$sd, d$alpha, d$normal), pw_mdd) bt <- c( sprintf("N = %s: effect size 0, power = %.2f%% (equals alpha)", n1, 100 * by[1]), sprintf("N = %s: MDD = %.2f, power = %.2f%%", n1, mdd, 100 * pw_mdd) ) if (!is.na(eff_tp)) { bx <- c(bx, eff_tp) by <- c(by, d$tp) bt <- c(bt, sprintf("N = %s: effect size %.2f gives target power %.1f%%", n1, eff_tp, 100 * d$tp)) } p <- p |> add_trace( type = "scatter", mode = "markers", x = bx, y = by, yaxis = "y", marker = list(color = blue, size = 9), showlegend = FALSE, hoverinfo = "text", text = bt, hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = blue, font = list(color = "white")) ) |> add_trace( type = "scatter", mode = "markers", x = mdd, y = d$alpha, yaxis = "y2", marker = list(color = red, size = 9), showlegend = FALSE, hoverinfo = "text", text = sprintf("N = %s: MDD = %.2f, 1-sided p-value = %.4f", n1, mdd, d$alpha), hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = red, font = list(color = "white")) ) } # Reference lines as dashed shapes with value labels shapes <- list() annots <- list() for (h in hl) { shapes[[length(shapes) + 1]] <- list( type = "line", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, yref = "y", y0 = h, y1 = h, line = list(dash = "dash", color = "black", width = 1) ) # Primary axis units (blue), left side annots[[length(annots) + 1]] <- list( xref = "paper", x = 0.005, xanchor = "left", yref = "y", y = h, yanchor = "bottom", text = paste0(signif(100 * h, 4), "%"), showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 10 * f, color = blue) ) # Secondary axis units (red), right side annots[[length(annots) + 1]] <- list( xref = "paper", x = 0.995, xanchor = "right", yref = "y2", y = h, yanchor = "bottom", text = format(signif(h, 4), scientific = FALSE), showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 10 * f, color = red) ) } for (v in vl) { shapes[[length(shapes) + 1]] <- list( type = "line", xref = "x", x0 = v, x1 = v, yref = "paper", y0 = 0, y1 = 1, line = list(dash = "dash", color = "black", width = 1) ) annots[[length(annots) + 1]] <- list( xref = "x", x = v, xanchor = "left", yref = "paper", y = 0.99, yanchor = "top", text = format(round(v, 2), nsmall = 2), showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 10 * f) ) } ttl <- paste0( "1-sided alpha = ", d$alpha, ", SD = ", d$sd, if (d$normal) " (normal approximation)" else " (t-test)", "
N = ", ns[1], " per arm (solid)", if (length(ns) == 2) paste0("; N = ", ns[2], " per arm (dotted)") else "" ) p |> layout( font = list(size = 12 * f), title = list(text = ttl, font = list(size = 14 * f)), hovermode = "closest", xaxis = list( title = list(text = "Effect size", standoff = 10), range = ax$x, zeroline = FALSE, automargin = TRUE, showline = TRUE, linecolor = "black", linewidth = 1, ticks = "outside", showgrid = isTRUE(input$gridlines), gridcolor = "#D0D0D0", tick0 = 0, dtick = nice_dtick(diff(ax$x)), minor = list(dtick = nice_dtick(diff(ax$x)) / 2, showgrid = isTRUE(input$gridlines), gridcolor = "#EDEDED") ), yaxis = list( title = list(text = "Rejection Probability (Power)", font = list(color = blue), standoff = 10), tickfont = list(color = blue), tickformat = ".1~%", tick0 = 0, dtick = 0.1, range = ax$y, zeroline = FALSE, automargin = TRUE, showline = TRUE, linecolor = blue, linewidth = 1, ticks = "outside", showgrid = isTRUE(input$gridlines), gridcolor = "#D0D0D0", minor = list(dtick = 0.05, showgrid = isTRUE(input$gridlines), gridcolor = "#EDEDED") ), yaxis2 = list( title = list(text = "1-sided p-value", font = list(color = red), standoff = 10), tickfont = list(color = red), tickformat = ".3f", tick0 = 0, dtick = 0.1, overlaying = "y", side = "right", range = ax$y, showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, automargin = TRUE, showline = TRUE, linecolor = red, linewidth = 1, ticks = "outside" ), shapes = shapes, annotations = annots, legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", yref = "container", y = 0.01, yanchor = "bottom"), margin = list(t = 80 * f, b = 135 * f, r = 30) ) |> config( displaylogo = FALSE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = list("toImage"), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = "png", filename = "type1_type2_error", width = 1400, height = 800, scale = 2) ) |> event_register("plotly_relayout") |> event_register("plotly_hover") |> event_register("plotly_click") }) # ── Axis synchronisation: numeric inputs <-> plot zoom ────────────────────── # Reset numeric axis inputs when the data range changes or on request observeEvent(list(input$eff_min, input$eff_max, input$reset_axes), { req(!is.na(input$eff_min), !is.na(input$eff_max)) updateNumericInput(session, "x_min", value = input$eff_min) updateNumericInput(session, "x_max", value = input$eff_max) updateNumericInput(session, "y_min", value = 0) updateNumericInput(session, "y_max", value = 100) }, ignoreInit = TRUE) # Numeric inputs -> plot observeEvent(list(input$x_min, input$x_max, input$y_min, input$y_max), { req(!anyNA(c(input$x_min, input$x_max, input$y_min, input$y_max)), input$x_min < input$x_max, input$y_min < input$y_max) yr <- c(input$y_min, input$y_max) / 100 plotlyProxy("plot", session) |> plotlyProxyInvoke("relayout", list( `xaxis.range` = c(input$x_min, input$x_max), `xaxis.dtick` = nice_dtick(input$x_max - input$x_min), `xaxis.minor.dtick` = nice_dtick(input$x_max - input$x_min) / 2, `yaxis.range` = yr, `yaxis2.range` = yr )) }, ignoreInit = TRUE) # Plot zoom -> numeric inputs observeEvent(ev_data("plotly_relayout"), { ev <- ev_data("plotly_relayout") if (!is.null(ev[["xaxis.autorange"]]) || !is.null(ev[["yaxis.autorange"]])) { updateNumericInput(session, "x_min", value = input$eff_min) updateNumericInput(session, "x_max", value = input$eff_max) updateNumericInput(session, "y_min", value = 0) updateNumericInput(session, "y_max", value = 100) return() } if (!is.null(ev[["xaxis.range[0]"]])) { updateNumericInput(session, "x_min", value = round(ev[["xaxis.range[0]"]], 3)) updateNumericInput(session, "x_max", value = round(ev[["xaxis.range[1]"]], 3)) } if (!is.null(ev[["yaxis.range[0]"]])) { updateNumericInput(session, "y_min", value = round(100 * ev[["yaxis.range[0]"]], 2)) updateNumericInput(session, "y_max", value = round(100 * ev[["yaxis.range[1]"]], 2)) } }) # ── Display size: option text size (CSS) and plot heights ─────────────────── output$dyn_css <- renderUI({ s <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(input$text_size)) / 100 if (length(s) != 1 || is.na(s)) s <- 1 px <- function(x) paste0(round(x, 1), "px") tags$style(HTML(paste0( ".well, .well label, .well .control-label, .well .checkbox, .well .radio, ", ".well .btn, .well .form-control, .well .selectize-input, ", ".well .selectize-dropdown, .well .irs { font-size: ", px(14 * s), "; }\n", ".well .form-control { height: ", px(34 * s), "; padding: ", px(6 * s), " ", px(12 * s), "; }\n", ".well .form-group { margin-bottom: ", px(15 * s), "; }\n", ".well hr { margin-top: ", px(12 * s), "; margin-bottom: ", px(12 * s), "; }\n", ".well { padding: ", px(19 * s), "; }" ))) }) plot_scale_r <- debounce( reactive(if (is.null(input$plot_scale)) 100 else input$plot_scale), 400 ) # Font and margin scale for the plots: follows the plot-size slider, but never # below 0.7 so text stays legible.
